headline: UBP bank: Dubai residential real estate more resilient than expected
summary: Swiss private bank Union Bancaire Privée said Dubai's residential real estate market showed better resilience than expected. The statement was reported by Al Bayan.
why: Union Bancaire Privée is a Swiss private bank whose market views are followed by wealthy clients and investors. Dubai's property market is a major focus for regional and international real estate capital.
